name: Family
short_desc: Baby and family log shared by the parents' phones: sleep, feeds, diapers and more.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Server for the Family apps: one shared log of a child's sleep, feeds, diapers, medicine and growth with a nap planner, synced between the caregivers' phones; the postpartum module, documents and findings (scanned and read on the server with Tesseract, full-text search), childcare and school (optional WebUntis import), reminders and a Kinderbetreuungsgeld calculator. Open it in the browser for the web app (sign in with a pairing code from the app). Weather, the contact search and WebUntis need outbound HTTPS.

form_fields.label: Daily backup hour
form_fields.hint: Hour (0-23, server time) of the nightly backup into data/backups; "off" disables it. Default 3.

form_fields.label: Backups to keep
form_fields.hint: How many nightly archives stay on the server. Default 30.

form_fields.label: Pairing page password
form_fields.hint: Optional. Turns on https://<domain>/pair, which shows the current pairing codes with a QR code, behind this password (any user name). Empty: no page.

form_fields.label: Pairing page from outside the home network
form_fields.hint: Off: the pairing page answers home-network addresses only.

form_fields.label: Java heap (documents import)
form_fields.hint: The server's heap, e.g. 256m. The rest of the memory is for reading scanned documents (Tesseract, one page at a time). Empty: 60 % of the container's memory.

form_fields.label: Google Places API key (contact search)
form_fields.hint: Optional. With a key the contact search asks Google Places (New) first, OpenStreetMap otherwise. Only the server sends the search text; restrict the key to the Places API (New) and set a budget alert.
